study_purpose.text: The study aims to record the effect of a program on mobility, balance, and health-related quality of life for women with osteoporosis and a history of vertebral fractures.

who_may_join.text: The study includes postmenopausal women aged 55-85 years with a documented vertebral or non-vertebral fracture, free of severe conditions, and able to understand the risks and benefits.

patient_facing_summary.text: This study involves postmenopausal women with a history of vertebral fractures. They attend a three-hour session and a three-month exercise program. Risks include minor discomfort during procedures. Details on specific inclusion and exclusion criteria are not clear.
